book: The trep tree (trep-tests, :104-226) under the top-level account trep:Root, then the invoice tree of create-test-invoice-data (5.17:bindings/guile/test/test-engine-extras.scm:487-849) under a second top-level Root, as :1007 builds it into the same book. Accounts are named tree:full name. TT's lookups at :1012-1017 find Root.Asset.Bank and Root.Income in the trep tree (made first) and A/Receivable and A/Payable in the invoice tree. YEAR (:117) is 2024: the monthly transfers are posted on the 3rd, 8th, 9th and 15th of each month of 2024. The invoices 0001-0007 are posted on 1980-09-01..07 (0005-0007 credit notes), 0008 on 1980-09-08 and paid on 1980-09-10.
optionValues: Options are those in effect for the run: default-testing-options (:127-143) and the test's changes after it, cumulative until the test makes new options; they include options TT sets to the template's default. "Every trep account" is gnc-account-get-descendants of the book's root before the invoice tree exists: trep:Root and its descendants. {"relative": name} is resolved from now (see dates); {"absolute": day} is gnc-dmy2time64 of that day, local (here UTC) midnight. Symbols are written without the quote. set-option! (:76-79) fails the test for an option the template lacks, so every option named exists.
cellSelection: GnuCash reads text at HTML table positions with get-row-col (:73-74), sxml->table-row-col (5.17:gnucash/report/test/test-report-extras.scm:96-109): table N of the document (table 1 is the Subtotal Table when shown, else the main table); row 0 is the <th> header row, row N the Nth row of <tbody> (negative from the end), null every row; column N the Nth cell (negative from the end), null every cell; the result is every text in document order, so empty cells drop out. "dropFirst" drops the first text (:667, cdr). "xpath" is an sxpath expression TT applies itself. "cells" lists selections compared by "relation". A check with "count" expects the number of nodes the xpath selects (th or td elements, empty ones included, or texts), "countAtLeast" a lower bound. "relation" says what GnuCash checks when it does not compare strings; "implied" gives the strings that satisfy it in this book where the note (design/notes/report-transaction-engine.md §4.3) works them out. "expected": [] means no table at all (a warning document).

renderOnly.note: null-test: renders with the template's defaults. In GnuCash's run the book is still empty; here the defaults select no account either, so it is the no-account warning in both
